key_insight: Class prototypes guide quantum data-embedding optimization with O(B) fidelity evaluations for B samples, replacing O(B²) pairwise evaluations.
engineering_relevance: The approach reduces embedding-optimization measurement costs while retaining competitive quantum kernel SVM classification performance.
method: Optimize prototype separation and sample-to-prototype compactness using a measurable lower certificate for class-ensemble distinguishability.
Combine task-specific quantum circuit architecture optimization with continuous embedding-parameter refinement.
Use a prototype-based classifier as a low-cost model-selection proxy, with multiple prototypes for multimodal classes.
evidence_signal: Tests on five benchmark datasets with up to 20 qubits report competitive quantum kernel SVM performance and particularly strong gains over budget-matched pairwise optimization on T-MNIST.
watch_item: Benefits are dataset-dependent, and linear fidelity-evaluation scaling does not establish linear total runtime or hardware measurement cost.
paper_title: Prototype-Guided Optimization of Quantum Data Embeddings with Linear Cost
